rationale: Severity ranked by worst post-contingency loading (post_flow/rating). out_l12 is critical: l13 loads to 88/70=125.7% (the only overload above the 100% threshold); next worst branch l23 at 95%. out_l13 peaks at 99% (l12), out_l23 peaks at 91% (l12), out_l34 peaks at 80% (l12). Islanding is detected topologically on the branch graph: bus b4 connects only via l34, so outaging l34 isolates b4; all other outages leave the graph connected. Hence out_l34 is flagged islanding while ranking is driven by loading severity.
